title: Extension by the empty set: adjunction with restriction, stalks, and j^{-1}j_! = id
statement:
Let $X$ be a topological space (sheaves on $X$ are sheaves on the site of open subsets of $X$ with open coverings [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]), $U\subseteq X$ an open subset, and let $j_{U,p!}$ and $j_{U!}$ be the extension by the empty set of presheaves and of sheaves of sets on $U$, with the sheafification $\theta_{\mathcal G}:j_{U,p!}\mathcal G\to j_{U!}\mathcal G$ [def-weil-pbc-sheafification], as in [def-weil-pbc-sets-extension-by-empty] (the presheaf formula there makes sense, and is used below, for any presheaf of sets $\mathcal G$ on $U$). For a presheaf of sets $\mathcal P$ on $X$ let $\mathcal P|_U$ be the presheaf on $U$ with $\mathcal P|_U(V)=\mathcal P(V)$ for $V\subseteq U$ open and the restriction maps of $\mathcal P$, and for a morphism $\varphi$ let $\varphi|_U=(\varphi_V)_{V\subseteq U}$; if $\mathcal P$ is a sheaf, so is $\mathcal P|_U$ (this is the restriction $j_U^{-1}$). For a presheaf of sets $\mathcal P$ on a space $T$ and $t\in T$ let $\mathcal P_t=\varinjlim_{W\ni t}\mathcal P(W)$ be the stalk, the colimit of sets [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] over the open neighbourhoods of $t$ ordered by reverse inclusion, with germs $s\mapsto s_t$. Then:
(1) For every presheaf of sets $\mathcal G$ on $U$ and every presheaf of sets $\mathcal P$ on $X$ the map $\operatorname{Hom}(j_{U,p!}\mathcal G,\mathcal P)\to\operatorname{Hom}(\mathcal G,\mathcal P|_U)$, $\psi\mapsto\psi|_U$ (note $(j_{U,p!}\mathcal G)|_U=\mathcal G$), is bijective, natural in $\mathcal G$ and $\mathcal P$: the inverse sends $\alpha$ to $\tilde\alpha$ with $\tilde\alpha_V=\alpha_V$ for $V\subseteq U$ and $\tilde\alpha_V$ the empty map $\emptyset\to\mathcal P(V)$ for $V\not\subseteq U$.
(2) For every sheaf of sets $\mathcal G$ on $U$ and every sheaf of sets $\mathcal F$ on $X$ the map $\operatorname{Hom}_{\Sh(X)}(j_{U!}\mathcal G,\mathcal F)\to\operatorname{Hom}_{\Sh(U)}(\mathcal G,\mathcal F|_U)$, $\psi\mapsto(\psi\circ\theta_{\mathcal G})|_U$, is bijective, natural in $\mathcal G$ and $\mathcal F$; the inverse sends $\alpha$ to the unique $\psi$ with $\psi\circ\theta_{\mathcal G}=\tilde\alpha$ ($\tilde\alpha$ as in (1)). So $j_{U!}$ is left adjoint to $\mathcal F\mapsto\mathcal F|_U$.
(3) For a sheaf of sets $\mathcal G$ on $U$ and $x\in X$: if $x\notin U$ then $(j_{U!}\mathcal G)_x=\emptyset$; if $x\in U$ then the map $\mathcal G_x\to(j_{U!}\mathcal G)_x$, $s_x\mapsto(\theta_{\mathcal G,V}(s))_x$ ($V\subseteq U$ an open neighbourhood of $x$, $s\in\mathcal G(V)$), is well defined and bijective.
(4) $(j_{U,p!}\mathcal G)|_U=\mathcal G$ for every presheaf of sets $\mathcal G$ on $U$, and for every sheaf of sets $\mathcal G$ on $U$ the morphism $\theta_{\mathcal G}|_U:\mathcal G\to(j_{U!}\mathcal G)|_U$ is an isomorphism of sheaves on $U$.

mathlib_searches.results: no extension by the empty set or by zero for sheaves on a topological space anywhere in Mathlib (only an unrelated hit in NumberTheory/MulChar/Basic.lean). The restriction j^{-1} is Topology.IsOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback (Functors.lean:125) = hf.functor.sheafPushforwardContinuous, precomposition with IsOpenMap.functor, continuous by Topology.IsOpenEmbedding.functor_isContinuous (SheafCondition/Sites.lean:165). Its left adjoint exists abstractly: Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafPullback (Sites/Pullback.lean:70, = sheafToPresheaf ⋙ lan along hf.functor.op ⋙ presheafToSheaf) with sheafAdjunctionContinuous (:75), so (2) holds for that functor. Identifying the left Kan extension along hf.functor.op with j_{U,p!} (value at V: colimit over the opens W ⊆ U with V ⊆ W, empty if V ⊄ U, G(V) if V ⊆ U) is a computation not in Mathlib; (1) as stated, (3) and (4) are not in Mathlib
mathlib_searches.verdict: no match (abstract left adjoint only; the identification with the explicit j_{U!} is not one line)
